comparison.objective: Tune and lock a damper versus cap four matching pens and sort them by color.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires hex-key seating, fine rotary adjustment, and torque control; record requires repeated cap-to-pen axial alignment, press fitting, and pick-and-place sorting.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two qualified dynamic stops; record awards credit per correctly retained matching cap and correctly released pen in its marked area.
comparison.reason: Axial capping and sorting do not test dynamic response tuning. Candidate rebound, overload, and drift tolerances are not numeric, but the objectives remain clearly unrelated.
